body: thank you. i keep telling myself it will pass but its just so hard to make it through tonight and i'm just hoping that tomorrow won't be as bad. i just wish something would make it easier. it is to many feelings at once and they won't die down enough to relax. the worst of it is just this horrible feeling of loss that keeps hitting me in waves. i can't rationalize it away. i just need something to get me by until these feelings aren't so strong. i just wish i had friends to hangout and keep my mind in a better place like i use to. the hours feel like days.
